capabilities: publish notes as new Quip documents
update existing Quip documents from notes
import Quip documents as new Obsidian notes
remap internal links between Obsidian notes and Quip documents via frontmatter keys
strip YAML frontmatter and inline embedded notes before publishing
extras: README includes a detailed format support table showing what converts to and from Quip (many formats like task lists, footnotes, math and callouts do not). Publishing notes over 1 MB fails because images are embedded as data urls. Only one Quip dev token can exist at a time across all automation tools. Setup details live partly in DEVELOPING.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to Quip or pull Quip documents into the vault as Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: This is a simple plugin for Obsidian ( to talk with Quip

requires.name: Quip corporate account meeting Automation API License Requirements

summary: Publishing plugin that converts Obsidian notes to Quip documents and imports Quip documents back as notes via three commands.
